# Chapter 08 · Sampling Theory of Least Squares {.unnumbered}
*Unbiasedness · Variance · Gauss–Markov · Normal Sampling Theory*

OLS의 대수적 성질을 sampling theory로 연결합니다. stochastic linear regression model, error decomposition, heteroskedasticity, Gauss–Markov, error variance와 exact normal theory를 다룹니다.

## Chapter Map

::: {.callout-note title="Reading Roadmap"}
- **8.1–8.3** OLS algebra에서 stochastic regression model과 error decomposition으로
- **8.4–8.6** unbiasedness, heteroskedasticity, classical variance formula
- **8.7–8.10** Gauss–Markov, variance estimation, exact normal theory, limits
- **8.11** 요약과 연습문제
:::
